Manufactured by [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]], the '''C/AF.9''' was a turreted anti-infantry weapon that was the predecessor to the [[DF.9/Legends|DF.9]] anti-[[Infantry/Legends|infantry]] battery. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was found amongst [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] that relied on older equipment, as well as planetary militias.<ref name="ISB2" />
